title: Kohler Mach Tripoint 1.0 GPF Touchless Urinal Flushometer (K-10UH00K30-CP)

comparisons.notes: Same model K-10UH00K30-CP, polished chrome, 1.0 gpf HES-powered; listed in stock
Same model K-10UH00K30-CP, polished chrome; ships in 7-10 business days

writeup: Kohler's Mach Tripoint touchless urinal flushometer (model K-10UH00K30-CP) is new on Woot for $358.99. It's a polished-chrome, 1.0 gpf sensor valve powered by a hybrid energy cell with a mechanical override, and authorized dealers charge $723.30 for the same model. Woot covers it with a 90-day Woot warranty, and only 2 were showing.
